components.note: The planetary camera chip, the first of the four SCI extensions, whose own header states DETECTOR 1. The other three extensions are the wide-field chips of the same exposure and are pinned with it.

A tangent-plane world coordinate system with SIP distortion, in the chip's own header. A picture carries no wavelength array, and the arcsec a pixel covers is measured from this transform rather than declared.

components.reason: calwp2 writes no error array. Table 2.1 of the WFPC2 data handbook lists the calibrated science data (.c0h, _c0f) and the data quality for it (.c1h, _c1f) as its calibrated science output, with no error plane among them, so nothing of the kind exists in the archive for this observation.

components.note: The calibrated data quality file, flag by flag as table 3.4 of the handbook defines them; value 8 is A/D converter saturation.

note: A 5 second F631N exposure of Europa on the planetary camera, programme 11085 (PI W. Sparks), the WFPC2 half of the visit whose ACS/SBC prism exposures are pinned in europa-11085.json. WFPC2 is delivered both as the waivered FITS the handbook describes (_c0f, one 800x800x4 cube and a table of the GEIS group parameters) and as ordinary multi-extension FITS (_c0m, one chip per extension). The multi-extension form is pinned here because each chip then carries its own header, and it is the same 800x800x4 samples. Table 2.1 of the handbook lists the calibrated science data and its data quality as the whole of calwp2's calibrated science output.
